units.rawText: Stop hesitating, Professor. One should accept gifts in times of need, you know.

units.rawText: Is it really so difficult a task to take this black knight I've given you?

spans.text: Is it really so difficult a task to take this black knight I've given you?

units.rawText: Have you heard the story of the Trojan horse? A "gods-given gift" brought destruction in the end.

spans.text: Have you heard the story of the Trojan horse? A "gods-given gift" brought destruction in the end.

units.rawText: I instead take up my rook on the other side of the board, leaving Eucharist's knight as it is.

units.rawText: I'll not have my city retrace the steps of those mindless acolytes.

spans.text: I'll not have my city retrace the steps of those mindless acolytes.

units.rawText: How impudent of you, Professor. First, you reject my gift, and now you seek to develop a second battlefield?
